system.effect:
You belong to the Riverkin Halfling Bloodline.

River Swimmer. You gain a Swim Speed equal to half your land Speed, rounded down to a whole foot. A Swim ❶ moves you up to that Swim Speed without a check in ordinary water. Dangerous currents or a specific hazard can still require checks. You must still breathe air.
system.description: Broad feet, slight webbing between the toes, and an easy buoyancy reveal a lineage at home in moving water.

rules.error: "SPEED:" is not a feature keyword: write TRAIT, SIZE, SPEED, VIGOR, SENSES, LANGUAGE, POINT, MANEUVER, TALENT, CHOICE, AURA, EFFECT, or `[<Constellation> trained]`; an effect goes in `[EFFECT <tag>: ...]`
